No. 1972/51 – FRIDAY, JUNE, 24, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT(CHAPTER) (Notice under Section 7)
My Reference No.: DIVWR/LND/AURAQ/10/5.

Land mini’s. Reference No.: LD/05/2009/PC/17. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act. No.28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land / servitude which is required for a Public purpose.
Description of the land or servitude to be acquired :

One (01) Lots of lands described below and situated within Palugama village 2521 F. V. P. paper 05, supplement 05 Hectares 0.658, supplement 05 Hectares 2.4084 of Werapola G. S. Division No. 1237 Sub Division of Dewamedde Korale in the Divisional Secretariat division Wariyapola of Kurunegala District in the North Western Province. Schedule has been annexed. 01. Lot No. 47 Name of the Land: Dangahamula Watta; Owner: T. M. Tikiri Bandara Thennakoon; Extent: 0.0658 Hectare. Boundries: North: lot No. 19 and 44; East: lot No. 19 and 44; South: lot No. 19; West: lot No. 19.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land / on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at divisional secretariat of Wariyapola on the 29th day of July, 2016 at 10.00 a.m. and further the hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate)on or before the 22nd July 22 day of 2016 the nature of there interested in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. Divisional Secretary, Wariyapola. Divisional Secretariat, Wariyapola. 22nd June, 2016 07- 523
